landing.intro: Create a room, build your own queue, and take turns playing music with friends.
landing.hostingNote: Use turntune in the cloud or run it on your own server.
landing.togetherIntro: Join the rotation when you have something to play. Stay and listen when you don’t.
landing.queueDescription: Your waiting queue is private. Your first track plays when your turn comes around.
landing.chatDescription: Chat in the room and give a track a Banger reaction.
landing.savedDescription: Save favorites and build sets for your next session.
landing.cloudDescription: We run the app. You bring the music and the people.
landing.selfHostDescription: Run your own instance for your friends or community.
landing.accountQuestion: Do my friends need an account?
landing.accountAnswer: Yes. An account is required to create or join a room. Signup on the cloud app currently requires an invite.
landing.turnQuestion: Do I have to take a turn?
landing.turnAnswer: No. Listen and chat without joining the DJ rotation. Choose Join as DJ when you want to play your picks.
landing.servicesQuestion: Which music services can I use?
landing.servicesAnswer: turntune supports YouTube, SoundCloud, Mixcloud, and configured Apple Music and Spotify integrations. Available services depend on the instance and room settings. Some require an account or subscription.
landing.matchingNote: Playback through another service depends on finding a matching recording.
landing.selfHostQuestion: What do I need to self-host?
landing.selfHostAnswer: A server running Docker Compose, a configured Supabase project, and the credentials for your chosen integrations. You manage configuration, updates, and backups.
